mainInputPlaceholder: What did you see or experience? Share the facts...
missionPara1: VocalWitness is a simple public square where anyone can share what they saw or experienced — with proof that it hasn’t been changed.
missionPara2: In a world full of edited videos and fake news, we give ordinary people a safe place to publish photos, voice notes, and reports. Everything is protected so the evidence stays trustworthy and your privacy stays intact.
forensicIntegrityDesc: Every photo, voice note and document gets a unique digital fingerprint on your device before upload. Others can confirm it is real without seeing your private details.
privacyFirstDesc: Speaking out is always your choice. We automatically remove location and device information. Phone checks are only temporary to stop spam and are never stored publicly.
communityStewardshipDesc: No single person decides what is true. Trust grows through honest participation and clear reputation. We stay neutral.
communitySupportedDesc: VocalWitness is kept alive by voluntary support. There are no ads, no paywalls, and no premium features locked behind payment.
trustStep1Desc: Everyone begins as a Citizen. You can raise your level with simple checks. Higher levels unlock stronger protection.
trustStep2Desc: Once something is published, it is locked. No one can quietly change or delete the original.
trustStep3Desc: VocalWitness is a neutral public square. We do not edit posts or push certain stories. The evidence speaks for itself.
aboutQuote: "In the age of noise, the clearest voice is the one that can prove it was never altered."
privacySubtitle: Your privacy is protected by strong technology — not just promises.
zkSubpoenaTitle: We Cannot Give What We Do Not Have
zkSubpoenaDesc: VocalWitness is built so that your personal identity never reaches our servers. If any authority asks for your private information, our answer is simple: We have nothing to give.
privacySec1Title: 1. Everything Important Happens on Your Device
privacySec1Para1: When you upload a photo, voice note, or document, the sensitive work is done inside your own browser before anything leaves your device:
privacySec1Bullet1: Metadata is removed: Camera model, GPS location, and other private details are automatically stripped.
privacySec1Bullet2: Digital fingerprint is created: Your browser makes a unique fingerprint of the file. Only this and the cleaned media are sent.
privacySec1Bullet3: Strong verification: You can prove you are a real person without revealing private identity details.
privacySec2Title: 2. What We Never Collect or Store
privacySec2Intro: For maximum safety we deliberately do not keep:
privacySec2Item1: Your real IP address — requests go through protection layers so your location is not linked to your posts.
privacySec2Item2: Phone numbers on any public record — phone checks are only temporary to stop spam and are never saved or shown.
privacySec2Item3: Government IDs, passports, biometrics, or your personal contact list.
privacySec3Title: 3. What We Do Process (Only What’s Needed)
privacyAccountInfoDesc: Your chosen username, security keys, and any trust badges you earn.
privacyContentDesc: Your reports, cleaned media, digital fingerprints, and timestamps.
privacyVerificationDesc: Proof that you are a real person — without revealing who you are.
privacyTechnicalDesc: Anonymous technical data used only to block attacks and bots.
privacySec4Text: Our design follows Articles 12 and 19 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights: everyone has the right to privacy and the freedom to share information without interference.
privacySec5Text1: VocalWitness is only a technical host. We do not write, approve, or fact-check the content people post.
privacySec5Text2: Each person is fully responsible for what they choose to publish.
privacySec6Title: 6. What Is Not Allowed & How to Report
privacySec6Text1: Harassment, sharing someone’s private personal details without consent, child sexual abuse material, and deliberately fake harmful media are strictly forbidden.
privacySec6Text2: If you see content that breaks these rules, please report it using the in-app button.
privacySec7Text: You can instantly clear your local browser data with the Quick Exit button. However, once a report is published and locked, it becomes a permanent record.
privacySec8Text: The VocalWitness platform, including its software, design, name, and logo, is the exclusive intellectual property of VocalWitness. You may not copy or reuse it without permission.
termsIntro: Welcome to VocalWitness — a public square where people can share real reports and evidence with strong protection. By using the platform you agree to these simple rules.
termsSection1Text: By creating an account, posting, or using VocalWitness, you agree to these Terms and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.
termsSection2Title: 2. Our Role – A Neutral Public Square
termsSection2Text: VocalWitness is a neutral platform. We give people tools to publish reports and protect evidence. We are not a news publisher, we do not decide what is true, and we are not a court of law.
termsSection3Intro: To keep the square safe from bots and spam, we use simple levels of verification:
termsTier1: Open Talk — Open to everyone who signs up. Basic public discussion.
termsTier2: Citizen Circle — Unlocked with a temporary phone check (used only to stop spam). Your phone number is never saved publicly.
termsTier3: Higher Trust / Verified Reports — Highest level. Your media gets a digital fingerprint on your device, private details are removed, and stronger protection is applied.
termsSection4Intro: You stay in control of your voice. Here are the clear rules:
termsConduct1: Your Choice: You decide whether to speak publicly or stay more private.
termsConduct2: Be Honest: Only post reports and evidence you genuinely believe are true.
termsConduct3: No Doxxing or Harassment: Do not share other people’s private details. Targeted harassment is not allowed.
termsConduct4: No Fake or Harmful Content: Creating deepfakes to harm someone is strictly forbidden.
termsSection5Text: You keep full ownership of everything you post. By publishing, you give VocalWitness permission to store and display your content. Once locked, it becomes part of a permanent record.
termsSection6Text: We use trusted global services for secure storage and protection against attacks. The platform is provided “as is”.
termsSection7Text: The platform is supported by voluntary donations. Donations do not give anyone special control or ownership.
termsSection8Text: To the fullest extent allowed by law, VocalWitness is not responsible for indirect damages arising from use of the platform or content posted by users.
termsSection9Title: 9. Your Responsibility for What You Post
termsSection9Text: You are responsible for what you publish. If someone has a problem with content, they should use our reporting process.
termsSection10Text: All rights in the VocalWitness platform, including its software, design, name, and logo, remain the exclusive property of VocalWitness.
termsSection10Text2: You may not copy, modify, or commercially exploit any part of the platform without written permission.
divineNaturalLawTitle: Your Right to Speak the Truth
divineNaturalLawDesc: Every person has the right to share what they have witnessed. This is protected under Article 19 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
subpoenaDefenseDesc: We cannot give away information that we never collected. Your identity stays protected.
subpoenaDefenseBullet1: No identity logs linked to your public posts.
subpoenaDefenseBullet2: Location and device details are removed in your browser before upload.
subpoenaDefenseBullet3: Strong technical protection for anonymous reporters.
opsecProtocolTitle: 2. Extra Safety Tips for High-Risk Situations
networkSafetySubDesc: In restrictive areas, use Tor or a trusted VPN. Avoid publishing on networks linked to your official ID.
physicalSafetySubDesc: Use a strong passcode. If you feel in danger, press the red Quick Exit button — it clears local data and leaves the site.
safetyProhibit1: Doxxing: Sharing someone’s private details without permission.
safetyProhibit3: Fake or Altered Evidence meant to harm others.
safetySection4Title: 4. How We Keep the Community Safe
safetySection4Text: Safety comes from community reporting and clear verification levels:
safetyModTier1: Open Talk — Open discussion for everyone.
safetyModTier2: Higher Trust — Stronger protection and reputation.
safetyGoalText: A safe public square where real reports can be shared and people are protected by design.
ledgerIntegrityPara1: Once a report is published, the rules make it extremely hard for anyone to edit or delete the original.
ledgerIntegrityPoint1: Database rules block updates and deletes on the record.
ledgerIntegrityPoint2: Digital fingerprints are created on your device.
ledgerIntegrityPoint3: Records are linked together for extra protection.
ledgerIntegrityClarification: Important: This is strong application-level protection, not a full public blockchain. The data lives in secure cloud storage.
ledgerIntegrityFuture: Future option: We may add extra public anchoring. This is not yet active.
